reasons: Palace's absences (Mateta suspended, Sarr, Tomiyasu, Riad out) are confirmed by two sources, but none is a regular starter, so no goal adjustment.
Liverpool's absences (Frimpong, Ekitiké, Bradley, Leoni) are confirmed by two sources and none is a known regular starter; Gravenberch is only a 75% doubt, so I keep the multipliers at 1.0.
Palace played Europe on 5 Nov on 3 days' rest against Liverpool's 4 after their own European game, so the rest gap is small and already largely reflected in the model.

Liverpool are missing Bradley, Frimpong, Ekitiké and Leoni, with Gravenberch doubtful, which trims their usual edge.
The model still has Liverpool ahead on xG (1.73 to 1.16), but the injuries narrow the gap.
